creation.description: Start as a level 1 Dwarf Fighter with the Soldier background. Choose your ability scores, starting gear, and look.

options.label: Dwarf
options.description: Dwarves are hardy, resilient, and can see in the dark.

options.label: Fighter · level 1
options.description: Choose a Fighting Style, call on Second Wind, and master three weapons.

options.label: Soldier
options.description: Athletics, Intimidation, a gaming set, and the Savage Attacker feat.

groups.label: Ability scores
groups.description_template: STR{0} DEX{1} CON{2} INT{3} WIS{4} CHA{5} · Soldier +{bonus_str}STR/+{bonus_con}CON

options.label: Chain mail, greatsword, flail, 8 javelins
options.description: Also includes a dungeoneer's pack, spear, shortbow, 20 arrows, a gaming set, healer's kit, quiver, traveler's clothes, and 18 gp to spend.

options.label: Defense
options.description: Defense raises your AC by 1 while you wear armor. Your greatsword, flail, and javelin use Graze, Sap, and Slow.

options.label: Party goes first
options.description: On a tie, heroes act before enemies. Tied heroes go in the order they joined.

offer_labels.defend-courier: Stand between the courier and the bandit
offer_labels.short-rest: Short Rest · 1 hour, no Hit Point Dice

courier_clue: The courier quietly tells you: the sealed packet is addressed to Vell at the Harbor Inn. Keep its destination between you.
escort_support_suffix: The courier now looks to {name} for support on the escort.

scenes.title: Gather at the Lantern Wharf
scenes.narration: A rain-soaked harbor waits beyond the lanterns. Share the room with your companions, then bring your heroes into the story.

scenes.title: The Broken Seal
scenes.narration: You reach the Lantern Wharf as a frightened courier slips from the shadows. Behind him, a boot scrapes across the boards.
scenes.speaker: Courier
scenes.dialogue: Please. I can't deliver this alone. The seal was broken before the ship reached port.

scenes.title: A Whisper in the Rain
scenes.narration: The courier presses the packet against his coat. A dockside enforcer approaches, one hand on a scimitar.
scenes.speaker: Courier
scenes.dialogue: The crest belongs to a ship that never appears on the ledger. I think someone aboard followed me.

scenes.title: An Oath at the Wharf
scenes.narration: The courier steadies himself behind you. The approaching enforcer draws a scimitar and demands the packet.
scenes.speaker: Courier
scenes.dialogue: If you help me reach the inn, I'll tell Vell what I saw aboard that ship. But he won't let us leave.

scenes.title: Steel Beneath the Lanterns
scenes.narration: The Bandit steps out of the rain, blade drawn, and bars the way to the packet.
scenes.rules_note: Combat uses the server-selected grid layout, source movement, range, cover and optional opportunity reactions. Heroes at 0 HP follow dying and death-save rules; enemies may die.
scenes.speaker: Bandit
scenes.dialogue: Hand over the packet. Last warning.

scenes.title: The Harbor Inn
scenes.narration: Warm lamplight frames the next chapter with your party and the courier. The sealed packet remains unresolved.
scenes.speaker: Courier
scenes.dialogue: We'll keep the packet close. Its journey isn't over.

scenes.title: The Courier's Road
scenes.narration: The courier lowers his shaking hands. The packet—and its secret—remain with your party.
scenes.rules_note: The opposing combatants are defeated. Dying heroes still need their timed death saves; victory does not wake or heal them.
scenes.narration_rested: The opposition was defeated. An uninterrupted hour has passed without Hit Point Dice or healing. Eligible heroes recover one Second Wind use; dead or stable 0-HP heroes are not automatically revived. The original victory and the courier's unresolved journey remain.
scenes.speaker: Courier
scenes.dialogue: You stood your ground. Come on. There's a light waiting for us at the inn.

scenes.title: A Costly Encounter
scenes.narration: The Bandit takes the packet and leaves.
scenes.rules_note: The party has been defeated. Heroes at 0 HP follow timed death saves; defeat does not restore hit points or held weapons.
scenes.narration_rested: The party was defeated. An uninterrupted hour has passed without Hit Point Dice or healing. Eligible heroes recover one Second Wind use; dead or stable 0-HP heroes are not automatically revived. That rest does not change the original defeat: the Bandit took the packet and left.

speakers.name: Courier
speakers.role: a frightened courier who needs the heroes' help to deliver a sealed packet

speakers.name: Bandit
speakers.role: a dockside bandit who attacks the heroes to take the packet
